data.heading: Our policies
data.subheading: The small print, kept short and readable.

items.question: Shipping policy
items.answer: Orders ship within 48 hours. Tracking details are emailed as soon as the parcel is collected.

items.question: Returns policy
items.answer: Return unused items within 30 days in their original packaging for a refund to your original payment method.

items.question: Privacy policy
items.answer: We collect only what we need to fulfil your order and never sell your personal data.

items.question: Warranty
items.answer: All hardware carries a two-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
